Every control below rebuilds the editor with real options. Your settings stay in this browser, and Share copies a link with the settings and the content.

Reading time assumes 200 words a minute. Stats does not have a file to copy or download; switch to HTML or Markdown for that.

What you can try here

  • OptionsTheme, interface language, bubble toolbar, Markdown shortcuts, sticky toolbar, read-only mode, a character limit, the focus colour and the height.
  • Sample contentAn article, a checklist, a table, a code block, formatting, and a Markdown document loaded through setMarkdown().
  • OutputThe live HTML and Markdown, word and character counts, a download of either format, and a share link.
  • Typing@ for mentions, / for the command menu, and Markdown shortcuts at the start of a line.

Every option is listed in the docs.
